name: ttdown-app
description: Teardown: upload a track and see how it is built. The v1 interface (Svelte 5). The earlier single-file page is ../index.html.

scripts.build: vite build --mode production && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs dist/production
scripts.build:bench: vite build --mode bench && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs dist/bench
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:bench
